lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one (1) or more of the following lines of authority: (1) Life ... (2) Accident and health or sickness ... (3) Property ... (4) Casualty ... (5) Variable life and variable annuity products ... (6) Personal lines ... (7) Credit ... (8) Title ... (9) Any other line of insurance permitted under Indiana laws or administrative rules.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the uniform application

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied licensure under section 12 of this chapter, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if:

exam_waiver_designations.quote: An individual who has attained the designation of chartered life underwriter, certified financial planner, chartered financial consultant, or another nationally recognized designation approved by the commissioner ... is not required to complete prelicensing education

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity, before acting as an insurance producer, is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: designated an individual licensed producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and administrative rules of Indiana.

temporary_license_available.quote: the commissioner, without requiring an examination, may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period of not more than one hundred eighty (180) days

temporary_license_max_days.quote: may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period of not more than one hundred eighty (180) days

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed producer of the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of an insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, contract, or other insurance business relationship with a producer shall notify the commissioner not more than thirty (30) days after the effective date of the termination

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: A licensed insurance producer may charge a commercial insured a reasonable fee to reimburse the insurance producer for expenses incurred by the insurance producer at the specific request of the commercial insured

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: A producer shall report to the commissioner any administrative action taken against the producer in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in Indiana not more than thirty (30) days after the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify a producer's licensing status through the centralized insurance producer license registry described in section 7 of this chapter.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: If a person is licensed as an insurance producer in another state and moves to Indiana, the person, to be authorized to act as an insurance producer in Indiana, must make application to become a resident licensee under section 6 of this chapter within ninety (90) days after establishing legal residence in Indiana.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: may, not more than twelve (12) months after the expiration date of the license, reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: The designated responsible producer, president, secretary, treasurer, and any other officer or individual who directs or controls the operations of the limited lines travel insurance producer complies with the fingerprinting requirements applicable to insurance producers in the resident state of the limited lines travel insurance producer.
